name: cuba-castro-plots-report.pdf
description: This document is the CIA Inspector General's 1967 report on plots to assassinate Fidel Castro, prepared for DCI Richard Helms by J.S. Earman with E.K. Greer and S.D. Breckinridge, released under the JFK Assassination Records Act, with the Preface covering its destruction-and-custody history and the body covering the schemes (poison cigars, the Gambling Syndicate/Roselli-Giancana operation, and the AMLASH/Rolando Cubela plot) and the Pearson leak inquiry.

metadata.title: Report on Plots to Assassinate Castro
